Meet the Creator

Ting Lott, RN

Ting Lott is a registered nurse with 17 years of nursing in psychiatric and crisis care, serving as a Crisis and Navigation RN. Before nursing, he spent 5 years as an elementary school teacher. He built this course the way he cared for patients — gently, patiently, and with a real understanding of what a racing mind feels like in the middle of the night.

Questions, Answered Honestly

Will this cure insomnia?

No — and this course won't promise that. It gives you proven, practical CBT-I-informed habits that many people find helpful for building calmer nights. If sleep problems persist, please see your doctor.

How fast can I start?

Tonight. The wind-down routine is ready to follow the same evening you get the course, and the first steps take only a few minutes.

Not sure where to begin?

Start with the free sleep quiz — it finds the one sleep habit to start with, and it's free whether or not you ever buy the course.

Is this medical advice?

No. This course is for education and encouragement only. It is not medical advice and does not replace care from your own doctor or clinician.
